name: lb2-custom
description: Evidence before the answer, for LongBench v2: a frame call with no document writes down what the question requires and the terms to look for; the document is cut into chunks, the chunks that score best against the question, the choices and the terms are scanned (every chunk when there are at most topChunks) for the passages that bear on the question and on each choice, quoted word for word and checked against the text; the lines holding a framed term join them, found by the harness; and the answer is given in the baseline's one call with the passages laid out in document order after the whole document when it fits the context, or from the passages alone when it does not.
